    21	async function nativeHost(verb: "dev" | "serve", prefix: string[], options: ProofOptions): Promise<ProofHost & { personas?: string[] }> {
    22	  const env = { ...process.env, ...options.env }, id = randomUUID();
    23	  const ports = portRange(env), timeout = deadline(options.timeoutMs, 30_000);
    24	  const args = [...(options.args ?? [])];
    25	  if (!args.includes("--port")) args.push("--port", ports);
    26	  const run = logged(resolveBinary(), [verb, ...prefix, ...args], { ...options, env: { ...env, SNAPBACK4_PROOF_ID: id, SNAPBACK4_SUPERVISOR_PID: String(process.pid) } });
    27	  try {
    28	    const url = await ready(run, line => {
    29	      const match = line.match(/^SNAPBACK4_READY verb=(dev|serve) generation=\d+ url=(http:\/\/[^ ]+) pid=(\d+)(?: |$)/);
    30	      if (!match) return;
    31	      if (match[1] !== verb || Number(match[3]) !== run.child.pid) throw Error("proof ready identity mismatch");
    32	      return match[2];
    33	    }, timeout);
    34	    const { response, body } = await fetchIdentity(`${url}/auth/config`, timeout);
    35	    if (!response.ok || body.proof_id !== id) throw Error("proof served identity mismatch");
    36	    let personas: string[] = [];
    37	    if (verb === "dev" && body.devDoors !== false) {
    38	      const status = await fetchIdentity(`${url}/dev/status`, timeout);
    39	      if (status.body.pid !== run.child.pid) throw Error("proof dev PID mismatch");
    40	      if (!Array.isArray(status.body.personas) || !status.body.personas.every(name => typeof name === "string")) throw Error("proof dev personas missing");
    41	      personas = status.body.personas;
    42	    }
    43	    return { url, ...(verb === "dev" ? { personas } : {}), pid: run.child.pid!, logs: run.logs, stop: () => stopChild(run.child, deadline(options.stopTimeoutMs, 5000)) };
    44	  } catch (error) { await stopChild(run.child, deadline(options.stopTimeoutMs, 5000)); throw error; }
    45	}
    46	export interface DevHost extends ProofHost {
    47	  personas: string[];
    48	  /** Read the current authoritative development time, including all clock advances. */
    49	  now(): Promise<number>;
    50	}
    51	/** The array form preserves the former startDev(args) recipe. */
    52	export function startDev(options: ProofOptions | readonly string[] = {}): Promise<DevHost> {
    53	  const opts: ProofOptions = Array.isArray(options) ? { args: options } : options as ProofOptions;
    54	  const args = [...(opts.args ?? [])];
    55	  const persistent = args.some(arg => arg === "--store" || arg.startsWith("--store=") || arg === "--no-memory");
    56	  if (persistent && args.includes("--memory")) throw new TypeError("proof startDev: --memory conflicts with --store/--no-memory");
    57	  // Native persistence is the default. --no-memory remains a consumed explicit alias.
    58	  const host = nativeHost("dev", [], { ...opts, args: args.filter(arg => arg !== "--no-memory") });
    59	  return host.then(host => ({ ...host, personas: host.personas!, now: async () => {
    60	    const { response, body } = await fetchIdentity(`${host.url}/dev/status`, deadline(opts.timeoutMs, 10_000));
    61	    if (!response.ok || typeof body.now !== "number") throw Error("proof dev clock unavailable; password-only dev requires explicit --unsafe-dev-doors for clock/fixture tools; use serve staging for real users");
    62	    return body.now;
    63	  } }));
    64	}

    66	  operatorToken(service?: string, days?: number): Promise<string>;

    71	// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.001#2-real-staging-accounts — operator authority stays in the existing local store proof; bulk setup refuses production.
    72	export async function startServe(deployDir: string, options: ServeOptions | readonly string[] = {}): Promise<ServeHost> {
    73	  if (typeof deployDir !== "string" || !deployDir.trim()) throw Object.assign(new TypeError("E_PROOF_USAGE: startServe(deployDir, options) requires a deployment directory as its first argument"), { code: "E_PROOF_USAGE" });
    74	  const opts: ServeOptions = Array.isArray(options) ? { args: options } : options as ServeOptions;
    75	  const directory = resolve(opts.cwd ?? ".", deployDir);
    76	  const host = await nativeHost("serve", [directory], opts);
    77	  const served: ServeHost = { ...host,
    78	    operatorToken: async (service = "operator", days = 1) => {
    79	      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(service) || !Number.isSafeInteger(days) || days < 1 || days > 3650) throw Error("proof operatorToken: invalid service or days (1..3650)");
    80	      const result = await cli(["token", "--service", service, "--days", String(days), "--release", directory, "--quiet"], opts);
    81	      if (result.code !== 0) throw Error(`proof operator token refused: ${result.stderr}`);
    82	      const token = result.stdout.trim();
    83	      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(token)) throw Error("proof operator token malformed");
    84	      return token;
    85	    },
    86	    seedAccounts: accountOptions => seedAccounts(served, accountOptions),
    87	  };
    88	  try { if (opts.seedUsers) served.sessions = await served.seedAccounts(opts.seedUsers); return served; }
    89	  catch (error) { await served.stop(); throw error; }
    90	}
    91	async function frontend(kind: "static" | "vite", dir: string, options: ProofOptions): Promise<ProofHost> {
    92	  const env = { ...process.env, ...options.env }, ports = portRange(env), timeout = deadline(options.timeoutMs, 30_000);
    93	  const cwd = resolve(options.cwd ?? ".");
    94	  const directory = resolve(cwd, dir);
    95	  // Vite is resolved from the app, never the proof package's development dependencies.
    96	  const vite = kind === "vite" ? createRequire(resolve(directory, "package.json")).resolve("vite") : "";
    97	  const run = logged(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(new URL("./proof-host.js", import.meta.url)), kind, directory, ports, vite], { ...options, env, detached: process.platform !== "win32", livenessPipe: true });
    98	  try {
    99	    const url = await ready(run, line => {
   100	      const match = line.match(/^SNAPBACK4_PROOF_READY (\{.*\})$/);
   101	      if (!match) return;
   102	      const data = JSON.parse(match[1]!);
   103	      if (data.pid !== run.child.pid || data.kind !== kind) throw Error("proof frontend PID mismatch");
   104	      return data.url as string;
   105	    }, timeout);
   106	    const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeout) });
   107	    if (response.headers.get("x-snapback4-proof") !== String(run.child.pid) + ":" + run.id) throw Error("proof frontend identity mismatch");
   108	    await response.body?.cancel();
   109	    return { url, pid: run.child.pid!, logs: run.logs, stop: () => stopChild(run.child, deadline(options.stopTimeoutMs, 5000)) };
   110	  } catch (error) { await stopChild(run.child, deadline(options.stopTimeoutMs, 5000)); throw error; }
   111	}

   115	export interface CliResult { code: number | null; signal: NodeJS.Signals | null; stdout: string; stderr: string; logs: ProofHost["logs"] }
   116	/** Waits for close (stdio drained), never merges the two streams. Nonzero is returned for refusal assertions. */
   117	export function cli(args: readonly string[], options: ProofOptions = {}): Promise<CliResult> {
   118	  return command(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(new URL("../bin/snapback4.js", import.meta.url)), ...args], { ...options, secret: options.secret || args[0] === "token" });
   119	}
   120	/** A bounded directly spawned build/tool command, with the same file logs. */
   121	export async function command(binary: string, args: readonly string[], options: ProofOptions = {}): Promise<CliResult> {
   122	  const run = logged(binary, args, { ...options, env: { ...process.env, ...options.env } });
   123	  try {
   124	    await bounded(run.closed, deadline(options.timeoutMs, 120_000), "proof cli close");
   125	    if (run.error()) throw run.error();
   126	    return { code: run.child.exitCode, signal: run.child.signalCode, stdout: run.stdout(), stderr: logText(run.logs.stderr), logs: run.logs };
   127	  } catch (error) { await stopChild(run.child, deadline(options.stopTimeoutMs, 5000)); throw error; }
   128	  finally { run.child.stdout?.destroy(); } // Secret capture must not pin the driver after a deadline.
   129	}
   130	async function successful(args: string[], options: ProofOptions) {
   131	  const result = await cli(args, options);
   132	  if (result.code !== 0) {
   133	    const stdout = result.stdout.trimEnd();
   134	    const tail = stdout.length > 4000 ? `…${stdout.slice(-4000)}` : stdout;
   135	    throw Error(`proof CLI failed (${result.code}): ${result.stderr}; stdout tail: ${tail || "(empty)"}; logs: ${result.logs.stderr}`);
   136	  }
   137	  return result;
   138	}
   139	export function deploy(dir: string, schema: string, options: ProofOptions = {}) {
   140	  if (typeof schema !== "string" || !schema) throw Error(`proof deploy requires an explicit saved schema file or directory; got ${JSON.stringify(schema) ?? String(schema)}: did npm run day2:proof pass versions/v1?`);
   141	  return successful(["deploy", dir, "--schema", schema, ...(options.args ?? [])], options);
   142	}
   143	export function rollback(dir: string, to: number | "latest", options: ProofOptions = {}) {
   144	  if (to !== "latest" && (!Number.isSafeInteger(to) || to < 1)) throw Error(`proof rollback requires an explicit immutable release target; got ${JSON.stringify(to) ?? String(to)}`);
   145	  return successful(["rollback", dir, "--to", String(to), ...(options.args ?? [])], options);
   146	}
   147	// @ref LLP 3000.011.003.000.000#11-wave-14-truthful-starter-custody-day4 — saved-source proof results expose authored cases separately from query sweeps.
   148	export interface TestSourceOptions extends ProofOptions { fixtureOnly?: boolean }
   149	export interface TestSourceResult extends CliResult { casesRun: number; casesSkipped: number }
   150	export function testSource(source: string, options: TestSourceOptions = {}): Promise<TestSourceResult> {
   151	  if (typeof source !== "string" || !source) throw Error(`proof testSource requires an explicit saved source file or directory; got ${JSON.stringify(source) ?? String(source)}: pass versions/v1`);
   152	  const { fixtureOnly = false, ...proofOptions } = options;
   153	  return successful(["test", "--source", source, ...(proofOptions.args ?? [])], proofOptions).then(result => {
   154	    const summaries = [...result.stdout.matchAll(/^SNAPBACK4_TEST_CASES (\{.*\})$/gm)];
   155	    if (summaries.length !== 1) throw Error(`proof testSource received no unique business-case summary; stdout tail: ${result.stdout.trimEnd().slice(-4000) || "(empty)"}; logs: ${result.logs.stdout}`);
   156	    let cases: { run: number; skipped: number };
   157	    try { cases = JSON.parse(summaries[0]![1]!) as { run: number; skipped: number }; }
   158	    catch { throw Error(`proof testSource received a malformed business-case summary: ${summaries[0]![0]}; logs: ${result.logs.stdout}`); }
   159	    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cases.run) || cases.run < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(cases.skipped) || cases.skipped < 0) {
   160	      throw Error(`proof testSource received invalid business-case counts: ${summaries[0]![0]}; logs: ${result.logs.stdout}`);
   161	    }
   162	    if (cases.run === 0 && !fixtureOnly) {
   163	      throw Error(`proof testSource ran no business cases (${cases.skipped} skipped); add test.cases.jsonl for this saved version, or pass { fixtureOnly: true } when fixture loading alone is the intended proof; stdout tail: ${result.stdout.trimEnd().slice(-4000) || "(empty)"}`);
   164	    }
   165	    return { ...result, casesRun: cases.run, casesSkipped: cases.skipped };
   166	  });
   167	}

   169	export function sandboxUnavailable(error: unknown): boolean {
   170	  return /No usable sandbox|Running as root without --no-sandbox|Failed to move to new namespace|SUID sandbox|sandbox.*Operation not permitted|Failed to unshare.*Operation not permitted/i.test(String(error));
   171	}
   172	export async function withBrowser<T>(options: LaunchOptions & Pick<ProofOptions, "cwd" | "logsDir"> & { chromium?: BrowserType }, proof: (context: BrowserContext) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
   173	  const directory = logsDir(options); mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
   174	  const err = openSync(join(directory, `${randomUUID()}.browser.stderr.log`), "wx", 0o600);
   175	  const { chromium: suppliedChromium, executablePath, cwd: _cwd, logsDir: _logs, ...other } = options;
   176	  const requireCaller = createRequire(resolve(options.cwd ?? process.cwd(), "package.json"));
   177	  let caller = suppliedChromium;
   178	  if (!caller) {
   179	    for (const peer of ["@playwright/test", "playwright", "playwright-core"]) {
   180	      let path: string;
   181	      try { path = requireCaller.resolve(peer); }
   182	      catch (error) { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "MODULE_NOT_FOUND") continue; throw error; }
   183	      const peerModule = await import(path);
   184	      caller = (peerModule.chromium ?? peerModule.default?.chromium) as BrowserType;
   185	      break;
   186	    }
   187	  }
   188	  caller ??= (await import("playwright-core")).chromium;
   189	  const launch = { ...other, ...(executablePath === undefined ? {} : { executablePath }), timeout: deadline(options.timeout, 30_000), logger: {
   190	    isEnabled: () => true,
   191	    log: (name: string, severity: string, message: string | Error) => { writeSync(err, `${name} ${severity}: ${String(message)}\n`); },
   192	  } };
   193	  const args = [...(options.args ?? [])];
   194	  if (process.getuid?.() === 0 && !args.includes("--no-sandbox")) args.push("--no-sandbox");
   195	  // Playwright owns its browser child over a pipe, including parent-exit cleanup.
   196	  // No WebSocket server or TCP debugging port is opened.
   197	  let browser;
   198	  try {
   199	    try { browser = await caller.launch({ ...launch, args, chromiumSandbox: !args.includes("--no-sandbox") }); }
   200	    catch (error) {
   201	      if (args.includes("--no-sandbox") || !sandboxUnavailable(error)) throw error;
   202	      browser = await caller.launch({ ...launch, args: [...args, "--no-sandbox"], chromiumSandbox: false });
   203	    }
   204	    let context: BrowserContext | undefined;
   205	    try {
   206	      context = await browser.newContext();
   207	      // Init scripts run on each document, including HTTP redirect destinations,
   208	      // before any application script samples its URL.
   209	      await context.addInitScript(() => {
   210	        if (window.top !== window || !/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) return;
   211	        const url = new URL(location.href);
   212	        url.searchParams.set("witness", "web");
   213	        history.replaceState(history.state, "", url.href);
   214	      });
   215	      context.setDefaultTimeout(30_000); context.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(30_000);
   216	      return await proof(context);
   217	    } finally {
   218	      try { if (context) await bounded(context.close(), 5000, "browser context close"); }
   219	      finally { await bounded(browser.close(), 5000, "browser close"); }
   220	    }
   221	  } finally { closeSync(err); }
   222	}
   223	const substringLocators = new WeakMap<Locator, Locator>();
   224	/** Strings match exactly by default; use exact:false or a RegExp for a row with more text. Excludes editable values. */
   225	export function renderedText(page: Page, text: string | RegExp, options: { within?: Locator; exact?: boolean } = {}): Locator {
   226	  const root = options.within ?? page, rendered = page.locator(":not(input):not(textarea)");
   227	  const locator = root.getByText(text, { exact: options.exact ?? true }).and(rendered);
   228	  if (typeof text === "string" && options.exact !== false) substringLocators.set(locator, root.getByText(text, { exact: false }).and(rendered));
   229	  return locator;
   230	}

   233	export { logsDir } from "./proof-process.ts";
   234	/** Returns the fresh nonempty text as a string, after it differs from previous. */
   235	export async function waitForFresh(locator: Locator, previous: string | null, options: number | { within?: Locator; timeoutMs?: number } = 30_000): Promise<string> {
   236	  const timeoutMs = deadline(typeof options === "number" ? options : options.timeoutMs, 30_000);
   237	  let substring = substringLocators.get(locator);
   238	  if (typeof options !== "number" && options.within) {
   239	    locator = options.within.locator(locator);
   240	    if (substring) substring = options.within.locator(substring);
   241	  }
   242	  const end = performance.now() + timeoutMs;
   243	  let count = 0, text: string | null = null, detail = "";
   244	  while (performance.now() < end) {
   245	    try {
   246	      count = await bounded(locator.count(), Math.max(1, end - performance.now()), "locator count");
   247	      text = count ? await bounded(locator.textContent({ timeout: Math.max(1, Math.min(1000, end - performance.now())) }), Math.max(1, end - performance.now()), "locator text") : null;
   248	      if (text && text !== previous) return text;
   249	    } catch (error) {
   250	      detail = error instanceof Error && (error.name === "TimeoutError" || /timed out after/.test(error.message))
   251	        ? "locator observation exceeded the remaining proof deadline" : String(error);
   252	      // A strictness/selector error needs its original repair, not a timeout.
   253	      if (error instanceof Error && error.name !== "TimeoutError" && !/timed out after/.test(error.message)) throw error;
   254	    }
   255	    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.min(25, Math.max(1, end - performance.now()))));
   100	fn command_lock(dir: &Path) -> Result<std::fs::File, String> {
   101	    #[cfg(unix)]
   102	    {
   103	        let file = snapback4_core::private_fs::auxiliary_file(
   104	            &dir.join("store.sqlite"),
   105	            &dir.join(".release-command"),
   106	            true,
   107	            0,
   108	        )
   109	        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   110	        file.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   111	        Ok(file)
   112	    }
   113	    #[cfg(not(unix))]
   114	    Err("release commands require Unix".into())
   115	}
   116	fn target(dir: &Path) -> Result<Option<Owner>, String> {
   117	    match deployment_lock(dir) {
   118	        Ok(owner) => Ok(Some(owner)),
   119	        Err(error) if error.contains("E_STORE_BUSY") => Ok(None),
   120	        Err(error) => Err(error),
   121	    }
   122	}
   123	fn status(
   124	    dir: &Path,
   125	    owner: Option<&Owner>,
   126	    after: u64,
   127	    items_after: Option<String>,
   128	    event: Option<u64>,
   129	) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
   130	    match owner {
   131	        Some(owner) => owner
   132	            .open_store(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))
   133	            .and_then(|mut s| s.release_status(after, items_after.as_deref(), event))
   134	            .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
   135	        None => crate::release_control::request(
   136	            dir,
   137	            crate::release_control::Command::Status {
   138	                after,
   139	                items_after,
   140	                event,
   141	            },
   142	        ),
   143	    }
   144	}
   145	fn activate(
   146	    dir: &Path,
   147	    owner: Option<&Owner>,
   148	    release: u64,
   149	    previous: Option<u64>,
   150	    revision: u64,
   151	    bound: snapback4_lang::Bound,
   152	    rollback: bool,
   153	    restore_dormant: bool,
   154	    allow_feed_adoption: bool,
   155	    options: &Options,
   156	) -> Result<(), String> {
   157	    let root = dir.join("releases").join(release.to_string());
   158	    let digest = crate::release_files::digest(&root)?;
   159	    if let Some(owner) = owner {
   160	        let project = Project { root };
   161	        let prepared = crate::native::prepare(&project, &bound).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   162	        crate::dev_worker::prepare_release(&project, &bound.schema)?;
   163	        crate::release_files::link_store(&project.root)?;
   164	        crate::release_files::durable(&project.root)?;
   165	        let mut pointer = crate::release_files::Pointer::prepare(dir, release, previous, rollback)?;
   166	        let activation = snapback4_core::engine::release::ReleaseActivation {
   167	            release,
   168	            expected_previous: previous,
   169	            expected_revision: Some(revision),
   170	            restore_dormant,
   171	            native_digest: prepared.installed.as_ref().map(|m| m.digest.clone()),
   172	            operation: if rollback { "rollback" } else { "deploy" }.into(),
   173	        };
   174	        let store = owner
   175	            .open_store(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5))
   176	            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   177	        let engine = snapback4_core::Engine::new_release_prepared(
   178	            store,
   179	            bound.schema,
   180	            bound.programs.into_iter().map(|p| p.program),
   181	            &activation,
   182	            allow_feed_adoption,
   183	        )
   184	        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   185	        pointer.finish(engine.generation())?;
   186	        receipt(release,engine.generation(),&engine.store().adoption_report,options);
   187	
   188	    } else {
   189	        let result = crate::release_control::request(
   190	            dir,
   191	            crate::release_control::Command::Activate {
   192	                release,
   193	                expected_release: previous,
   194	                expected_revision: revision,
   195	                digest,
   196	                rollback,
   197	                restore_dormant,
   198	                allow_feed_adoption,
   199	            },
   200	        )?;
   201	        if options.json {println!("{}",result);} else {
   202	            println!("release {release} is current as generation {}; {}; running serve adopted the release",result["generation"],result["adoption"].as_str().unwrap_or("adopted"));
   203	            for fill in result["backfills"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().filter_map(|f|f.as_str()) {println!("  backfill: {fill}");}
   204	            if options.flags.contains_key("verbose") {println!("{}",result["details"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));}
   205	        }
   206	    }
   207	    Ok(())
   208	}
   209	fn report(verb: &str, result: Result<(), String>) -> i32 {
   210	    // @ref LLP 3000#contended-read-serving — release completion owns no engine/lease; bound the final diagnostic drain.
   211	    // The background writer must get a chance to emit adoption estimates before
   212	    // this short-lived command exits. Broken/stalled output cannot hold exit.
   213	    let _ = snapback4_core::diagnostics::drain(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
   214	    match result {
   215	        Ok(()) => 0,
   216	        Err(error) => {
   217	            eprintln!("{verb}: {error}");
   218	            1
   219	        }
   220	    }
   221	}
   222	
   223	pub fn deploy(options: &Options) -> i32 {
   224	    report(
   225	        "deploy",
   226	        (|| {
   227	            let dir = canonical_directory(options)?;
   228	            let _command = command_lock(&dir)?;
   229	            let existed = dir.join("store.sqlite").exists();
   230	            let checking=options.flags.contains_key("check");
   231	            let _deployment = if checking {None} else {target(&dir)?};
   232	            if let Some(owner) = &_deployment { owner.report_reclaim(options.flags.contains_key("verbose")); }
   233	            let project = super::proof_source::project(options, "schema")?;
   234	            let sources = super::proof_source::sources(&project, options, "schema")?;
   235	            let bound = compiled_or_exit(super::proof_source::compile(&sources, options, "schema"), options.json);
   236	            if options.flags.contains_key("staging") {
   237	                staging::classify(&dir, _deployment.as_ref(), existed, checking)?;
   238	            }
   239	            std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("releases")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   240	            let held = if checking {
   241	                if dir.join("store.sqlite").exists() {snapback4_core::Store::open_read_only(&dir.join("store.sqlite")).and_then(|mut s|s.release_status(0,None,None)).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?}
   242	                else {serde_json::json!({"release":null,"revision":0,"generation":1})}
   243	            } else {status(&dir, _deployment.as_ref(), 0, None, None)?};
   244	            let previous = if let Some(owner) = _deployment.as_ref() {
   245	                current(&dir, owner)?
   246	            } else {
   247	                held["release"].as_u64()
   248	            };
   249	            let revision = held["revision"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
   250	            check_change(&dir, previous, &bound, options, None)?;
   251	            let releases = dir.join("releases").canonicalize().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   252	            let stage = releases.join(format!(".stage-{}", std::process::id()));
   253	            if stage.exists() {std::fs::remove_dir_all(&stage).map_err(|e|e.to_string())?;}
   254	            std::fs::create_dir(&stage).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   255	            let _cleanup=Stage(stage.clone());
   256	            std::fs::create_dir(stage.join("snapback")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   257	            let source_hash = {
   258	                use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
   259	                let mut hash = Sha256::new();
   260	                let mut ordered = sources.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();

// @ref LLP 3000.011.003.000.000#1 — direct children, file logs and bounded cleanup own proof orchestration.
import { spawn, type ChildProcess } from "node:child_process";
import { closeSync, mkdirSync, openSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { setTimeout as sleep } from "node:timers/promises";
import { stripVTControlCharacters } from "node:util";

const children = new Set<ChildProcess>();
process.once("exit", () => { for (const child of children) child.kill("SIGKILL"); });
export function register(child: ChildProcess): void {
  children.add(child);
  child.once("exit", () => children.delete(child));
  child.on("error", () => children.delete(child));
}
export interface ProofOptions {
  cwd?: string;
  env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
  args?: readonly string[];
  timeoutMs?: number;
  stopTimeoutMs?: number;
  logsDir?: string;
  /** Keep stdout in memory only (stderr remains diagnostic evidence). */
  secret?: boolean;
  /** Internal: a frontend keeper owns this private process group. */
  detached?: boolean;
  /** Internal: the frontend observes parent death through stdin EOF. */
  livenessPipe?: boolean;
}
export interface ProofHost {
  url: string;
  pid: number;
  logs: { stdout: string; stderr: string };
  stop(): Promise<void>;
}
export function deadline(ms: number | undefined, fallback: number): number {
  const value = ms ?? fallback;
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1) throw new RangeError("proof timeout must be positive and finite");
  return value;
}
export async function bounded<T>(work: Promise<T>, ms: number, label: string): Promise<T> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([work, new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(Error(`${label} timed out after ${ms} ms`)), ms);
    })]);
  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
/** Attempts every cleanup, even if a preceding step fails or stalls. */
export async function cleanup(...steps: Array<(() => unknown | Promise<unknown>) | undefined>): Promise<void> {
  const errors: unknown[] = [];
  for (const step of steps) if (step) {
    try { await bounded(Promise.resolve().then(step), 10_000, "proof cleanup"); }
    catch (error) { errors.push(error); }
  }
  if (errors.length) throw new AggregateError(errors, "proof cleanup failed");
}
export async function stopChild(child: ChildProcess | Pick<ProofHost, "url" | "stop">, graceMs = 5000): Promise<void> {
  deadline(graceMs, 5000);
  if (child && "url" in child && typeof child.url === "string" && typeof child.stop === "function") {
    await bounded(Promise.resolve().then(() => child.stop()), graceMs + 5000, "host stop"); return;
  }
  if (!child || !("kill" in child) || typeof child.kill !== "function" || typeof child.once !== "function"
      || !(child.exitCode === null || typeof child.exitCode === "number")
      || !(child.signalCode === null || typeof child.signalCode === "string")) {
    throw new TypeError("stopChild needs a ChildProcess or { url, stop }");
  }
  if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) return;
  let done!: () => void;
  const exited = new Promise<void>(resolve => { done = resolve; });
  child.once("exit", done);
  child.once("error", done);
  try {
    child.kill("SIGTERM");
    try { await bounded(exited, graceMs, "SIGTERM"); }
    catch {
      child.kill("SIGKILL");
      await bounded(exited, 5000, "SIGKILL reap");
    }
  } finally { child.removeListener("exit", done); child.removeListener("error", done); }
}
export function portRange(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string {
  const low = env.PORT_LO, high = env.PORT_HI;
  if (low === undefined && high === undefined) return "0";
  if (!low || !high || !/^\d+$/.test(low) || !/^\d+$/.test(high)
      || Number(low) < 1 || Number(high) > 65535 || Number(low) > Number(high)) {
    throw Error("PORT_LO and PORT_HI must both specify an inclusive range, 1 <= low <= high <= 65535");
  }
  return `${Number(low)}-${Number(high)}`;
}
/** App-local evidence survives harness cleanup of its temporary root. */
export function logsDir(options: Pick<ProofOptions, "cwd" | "logsDir"> = {}): string {
  return resolve(options.cwd ?? ".", options.logsDir ?? "logs");
}
export function logged(command: string, args: readonly string[], options: ProofOptions = {}) {
  const cwd = resolve(options.cwd ?? "."), id = randomUUID();
  const directory = logsDir(options); mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const logs = { stdout: join(directory, `${id}.stdout.log`), stderr: join(directory, `${id}.stderr.log`) };
  if (options.secret) writeFileSync(logs.stdout, "stdout withheld: secret command (returned only to caller)\n", { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });
  const out = options.secret ? undefined : openSync(logs.stdout, "wx", 0o600), err = openSync(logs.stderr, "wx", 0o600);
  let child: ChildProcess;
  try { child = spawn(command, [...args], { cwd, detached: options.detached ?? false, env: { ...(options.env ?? process.env), SNAPBACK4_PROOF_LAUNCH: id }, stdio: [options.livenessPipe ? "pipe" : "ignore", options.secret ? "pipe" : out!, err] }); }
  finally { if (out !== undefined) closeSync(out); closeSync(err); }
  // Secret stdout never reaches a file, even briefly. Callers still receive it.
  let stdout = "";
  child.stdout?.setEncoding("utf8");
  child.stdout?.on("data", chunk => { stdout += chunk; });
  register(child);
  child.stdin?.on("error", () => {});
  let error: Error | undefined;
  child.on("error", value => { error = value; });
  const closed = new Promise<void>(resolve => child.once("close", () => resolve()));
  return { child, logs, id, closed, stdout: () => options.secret ? stdout : logText(logs.stdout), error: () => error };
}
export const logText = (path: string): string => readFileSync(path, "utf8");
export async function ready(run: ReturnType<typeof logged>, parse: (line: string) => string | undefined, timeoutMs: number): Promise<string> {
  const end = performance.now() + timeoutMs;
  let outAt = 0, errAt = 0;
  while (performance.now() < end) {
    if (run.error()) throw run.error();
    if (run.child.exitCode !== null || run.child.signalCode !== null) {
      throw Error(`proof child exited before ready (${run.child.exitCode ?? run.child.signalCode}); ${run.logs.stderr}\n${logText(run.logs.stderr).slice(-4000)}`);
    }
    for (const [path, offset, stream] of [[run.logs.stdout, outAt, "out"], [run.logs.stderr, errAt, "err"]] as const) {
      const text = logText(path);
      const complete = text.lastIndexOf("\n") + 1;
      for (const line of text.slice(offset, complete).split("\n")) {
        const url = parse(stripVTControlCharacters(line).trim());
        if (url) return url;
      }
      if (stream === "out") outAt = complete; else errAt = complete;
    }
    await sleep(25);
  }
  throw Error(`proof child ready timed out after ${timeoutMs} ms; logs: ${run.logs.stdout}, ${run.logs.stderr}`);
}

fn close_doors(shared: &Shared, engine: &mut Engine) {

fn stage_slow_dev_bodies_cannot_retain_authority_after_password_adoption() {

#[test]
fn stage_actions_and_session_routes_revalidate_before_durable_admission() {
    let source = "use server\nuse identity\nuse personas alice\naction work()\nroute report: post \"/report\" wait 1s\n";
    for password in [false, true] {
        for path in ["/a/work?wait=0", "/report", "/actions/keep/cancel"] {
            let host = Host::with_default_doors(source);
            // Existing work must remain uncancelled when cancellation loses
            // its persona authority while queued behind the writer.
            {
                let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
                engine.request_action("work", "keep", Context::new("dev:alice", BTreeMap::new()).at(host.shared.now())).unwrap();
            }
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let before: i64 = engine.store().conn().query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _requests", [], |row|row.get(0)).unwrap();
            let address = host.address;
            let task = thread::spawn(move || {
                let payload = r#"{"id":"new","args":{}}"#;
                exchange_held(address, Duration::from_secs(10), &format!("POST {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\nx-snapback-persona: alice\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{payload}",payload.len()))
            });
            wait_until(|| host.shared.engine.waiting() > 0);
            let next = if password { source.replace("use identity", "use identity password") }
                else { source.replace("use personas alice\n", "") };
            let bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(), next)]);
            let generation = engine.adopt(bound.schema.clone(), bound.programs.iter().map(|p|p.program.clone())).unwrap();
            lock(&host.shared.readers).replace(&engine, &bound.refusal_sites);
            *lock(&host.shared.bound) = bound; *lock(&host.shared.generation) = generation;
            drop(engine);
            let response = task.join().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(status(&response), 401, "password={password}, {path}: {response}");
            assert_eq!(body(&response)["denied"]["code"], "E_AUTH");
            let mut engine = lock(&host.shared.engine);
            let after: i64 = engine.store().conn().query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _requests", [], |row|row.get(0)).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(after, before, "refused admission creates no durable work");
            assert!(!engine.action_request_at("keep", "dev:alice", host.shared.now()).unwrap().cancelled);
            let claims = engine.claim_actions("service:worker", None, 10, 1000, 60, host.shared.now()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(claims.len(), 1, "only previously admitted work is claimable");
            assert_eq!(claims[0].request.id, "keep");
        }
    }
}

   819	    let metadata = shared.read_identity();
   820	    match metadata {
   821	        Ok((store_id, head, generation)) => respond_timed(request, shared, status, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&why), "store_id": store_id, "head": head, "generation": generation })),
   822	        Err(why) => respond_timed(request, shared, 503, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&why) })),
   823	    }
   824	}
   825	
   826	// @ref LLP 3000.009#5.1 — a racing id conflict is a terminal input refusal, not a transport failure.
   827	fn mutation_error_status(refusal: &Refusal) -> u16 {
   828	    if refusal.retryable { 503 } else if matches!(refusal.code.as_str(), "E_ID_REUSED" | "E_DELIVERY_BINDING") { 200 } else { 500 }
   829	}
   830	
   831	fn handle(mut request: Request, shared: &Shared) {
   832	    // @ref LLP 3000.000.000#93-http-admission-and-reporting — lookup, decode and execution share the admitted release.
   833	    let operation = request.url().split('?').next().is_some_and(|p| p.starts_with("/q/") || p.starts_with("/m/"));
   834	    let _scope=crate::release_requests::Scope::begin(*lock(&shared.generation));
   835	
   836	    request.set_cleanup_guard(latency::FinishOnDrop);
   837	    #[cfg(test)] test_work(&shared.request_work);
   838	    let method = request.method().clone();
   839	    let url = request.url().to_owned();
   840	    let path = url.split('?').next().unwrap_or("").to_owned();
   841	    let _evidence = dev_refusals::response::begin(shared, &path);
   842	    // @ref LLP 3000.033#1.2 — closed read allow-list precedes every handler,
   843	    // declared route, dev door and idempotency replay. Refusals carry no head.
   844	    // Read tokens and malformed credentials always enter this guard. Otherwise
   845	    // authenticated full-token handlers retain their input/refusal ordering.
   846	    // Public and dev doors must resolve any supplied credential before dispatch.
   847	    let public_door = path.starts_with("/dev/") || matches!(path.as_str(), "/seed" | "/auth/signup" | "/auth/login" | "/auth/guest")
   848	        || path == token::ENDPOINT || routes::declared(shared, &url).is_some();
   849	    if request.headers().iter().any(|h| h.field.equiv("authorization")
   850	        && (public_door || crate::auth::parse_bearer(h.value.as_str()).is_none_or(|token| token.starts_with("ro.")))) {
   851	        match principal_of(&request, shared) {
   852	            Ok((_, _, snapback4_core::identity::SessionScope::Read)) if !read_permitted(&method, &path) =>
   853	                return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({"denied": Refusal::new("E_READ_ONLY", "auth", "this read session permits reads only; use a full session for writes").guide("read-only")})),
   854	            // @ref LLP 3000.019#3.4 — the private-proof door keeps one indistinguishable refusal.
   855	            Err(_) if path == token::ENDPOINT => return token::denied(request),
   856	            Err(why) => return respond_timed(request, shared, if why.retryable {503} else {401}, json!({"denied": refusal_json(&why)})),
   857	            _ => {}
   858	        }
   859	    }
   860	    if path == token::ENDPOINT { return token::handle(request, shared); }
   861	    // This exact declared POST path is the only non-loopback development
   862	    // exception. Core doors, mismatched methods and query variants stay fenced.
   863	    if method == Method::Post && let Some((name, route)) = routes::declared(shared, &url) {
   864	        return routes::ingress(request, shared, &name, route);
   865	    }
   866	    let ephemeral_request = method == Method::Post && path.strip_prefix("/m/").is_some_and(|op| lock(&shared.bound).schema.operations.get(op).is_some_and(|f| f.ephemeral));
   867	    let reject = |request, status, refusal: Refusal| {
   868	        if ephemeral_request { ephemeral::failed(request,shared,None,refusal); }
   869	        else if path.starts_with("/q/") { operation_refusal(request, shared, status, refusal); }
   870	        else { respond_timed(request,shared,status,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&refusal)})); }
   871	    };
   872	    if let Err(refusal) = dev_request(&request, shared) {
   873	        if ephemeral_request { return ephemeral::failed(request, shared, None, refusal); }
   874	        respond_with_sync(request, 403, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&refusal) }), false, None, Some(shared));
   875	        return;
   876	    }
   877	    // /dev/token has already been routed through its mutual local-owner proof.
   878	    if shared.personas && (path.starts_with("/dev/") || path == "/seed") && !shared.dev_doors() {
   879	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&dev_doors::closed())}));
   880	    }
   881	    if path.starts_with("/dev/clock") && !shared.personas {
   882	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&crate::dev_clock::release()) }));
   883	    }
   884	    // Discovered control requests bind to the inspected serving instance.
   885	    // A listener replaced between GET status and POST cannot receive the action.
   886	    if method==Method::Post && matches!(path.as_str(), "/dev/clock/advance"|"/dev/reset"|"/dev/latency/reset") {
   887	        match single_header(&request,"x-snapback-dev-instance") {
   888	            Ok(None)=>{},
   889	            Ok(Some(instance)) if shared.dev_identity.as_ref().is_some_and(|i| i.instance==instance)=>{},
   890	            _=>return respond_timed(request,shared,409,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_INPUT","input","dev instance changed since discovery; rerun the command to select the live host"))})),
   891	        }
   892	    }
   893	    if (method == Method::Get && path == "/dev/latency") || (method == Method::Post && path == "/dev/latency/reset") {
   894	        return latency::endpoint(request, shared, method == Method::Post);
   895	    }
   896	    // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.000.000#3-proof-fixture-loading — development field types need no principal.
   897	    if method == Method::Get && path == "/dev/catalog" {
   898	        if !shared.personas { return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "fixture catalog requires dev"))})); }
   899	        let bound = lock(&shared.bound);
   900	        let tables: Vec<Json> = bound.schema.visible_tables().map(|(name, table)| json!({ "name": name, "fields": table.columns.iter().filter(|(column, _)| !table.private_field(column) && !table.engine_field(column)).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>() })).collect();
   901	        drop(bound);
   902	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 200, json!({ "tables": tables }));
   903	    }
   904	    if method == Method::Get && path == "/dev/status" {
   905	        if !shared.personas { return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "status inspection requires dev"))})); }
   906	        // No engine lock: doctor must remain usable while an adoption waits on SQLite.
   907	        let generation = *lock(&shared.generation);
   908	        let personas = lock(&shared.bound).personas.clone();
   909	        let status = lock(&shared.adoption);
   910	        let now = shared.now();
   911	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 200, json!({"instance":shared.dev_identity.as_ref().map(|i| &i.instance), "initialStoreId":shared.dev_identity.as_ref().map(|i| &i.initial_store_id), "pid":std::process::id(), "wrapperPid":crate::supervisor::pid(), "storeId":status.store_id, "project":shared.project, "temporary":shared.temporary, "generation":generation, "adoption":status.failure, "now":now, "clockOffsetMs":now - snapback4_core::now_ms(), "skewMs":now - snapback4_core::now_ms(), "personas":personas, "scheduling":crate::thread_priority::diagnostics(), "fileDescriptors":crate::host_limits::diagnostics()}));
   912	    }
   913	    if method == Method::Get && path == "/dev/clock/status" { return maintenance::clock_status(request, shared); }
   914	    if method == Method::Options {
   915	        respond_empty(request, 204);
   916	        return;
   917	    }
   918	    if method == Method::Post && path == "/seed" && !shared.personas {
   919	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "seeding is a development door")) }));
   920	    }
   921	    if path == "/dev/reset" && !shared.personas {
   922	        return respond_timed(request, shared, 403, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&dev_doors::reset_release()) }));
   923	    }
   924	    // Check identity before upload admission or allocating any large body.
   925	    // The route rechecks after reading, so expiry/revocation during a slow
   926	    // upload cannot retain the authority held at its start.
   927	    // Logout's body is only 4 KiB and its sole authentication happens inside
   928	    // the SQLite writer transaction that closes the live session family.
   929	    if method == Method::Post && (path == "/assets" || path.starts_with("/assets/intent/") || path == "/sync" || path.starts_with("/q/") || path.starts_with("/following/") || path.starts_with("/m/") || path.starts_with("/a/")
   930	        || (path.starts_with("/actions/") && path.ends_with("/cancel"))
   931	        || matches!(path.as_str(), "/auth/refresh" | "/auth/logout-all")) {
   932	        if let Err(refusal) = principal_of(&request, shared) {
   933	            // No authenticated viewer: metadata cannot disclose a store head.
   934	            if path.starts_with("/q/") { return respond_timed(request, shared, if refusal.retryable { 503 } else { 401 }, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&refusal)})); }
   935	            return reject(request, if refusal.retryable { 503 } else { 401 }, refusal);
   936	        }
   937	    }
   938	    if method == Method::Post && (path == "/auth/revoke" || path.starts_with("/routes/verify/") || (path.starts_with("/actions/") && !path.ends_with("/cancel"))) {
   939	        if let Err(refusal) = service_of(&request, shared) {
   940	            return reject(request, if refusal.retryable { 503 } else { 401 }, refusal);
   941	        }
   942	    }
   943	    if method == Method::Get && matches!(path.as_str(), "/" | "/schema" | "/api.ts" | "/native.wasm" | "/changes") {
   944	        if let Err(refusal) = principal_of(&request, shared) {
   945	            return reject(request, if refusal.retryable { 503 } else { 401 }, refusal);
   946	        }
   947	    }
   948	    let _upload_permit = if method == Method::Post && path == "/assets" {
   949	        match crate::assets::admit(shared) {
   950	            Some(permit) => Some(permit),
   951	            None => {
   952	                let mut refusal = Refusal::new("E_RATE_LIMIT", "auth", "too many concurrent uploads; retry shortly");
   953	                refusal.retryable = true;
   954	                return respond_timed(request, shared, 429, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&refusal) }));
   955	            }
   956	        }
   957	    } else { None };
   958	    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
   959	    // @ref LLP 3000.038#3 — a file upload streams at most the schema's largest file bound, refused before reading when declared larger.
   960	    let file_upload = method == Method::Post && path == "/assets" && crate::assets::is_file_upload(&url);
   961	    if method == Method::Post {
   962	        let ceiling = match path.as_str() {
   963	            "/assets" if file_upload => match crate::assets::file_ceiling(shared) {
   964	                Ok(ceiling) => ceiling,
   965	                Err(refusal) => return reject(request, 415, refusal),
   966	            },
   967	            "/assets" => crate::assets::UPLOAD_CEILING,
   968	            "/seed" | "/dev/reset" => SEED_REQUEST_CEILING,
   969	            "/sync" => SYNC_REQUEST_CEILING,
   970	            path if path.starts_with("/auth/") => crate::auth::BODY_CEILING,
   971	            path if path.starts_with("/following/") => 64 * 1024,
   972	            _ => JSON_REQUEST_CEILING,
   973	        };
   974	        let length = request.body_length();
   975	        let too_large = || if file_upload {
   976	            Refusal::new("E_ASSET_TOO_LARGE", "asset", format!("the file exceeds {ceiling} bytes, the largest file column's bound")).guide("assets")
   977	        } else {
   978	            Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", format!("the request body exceeds its {ceiling}-byte limit; split it into smaller requests"))
   979	        };
   980	        if length.is_some_and(|length| length > ceiling) {
   981	            return reject(request, 413, too_large());
   982	        }
   983	        let mut buffer = [0; 8 * 1024];
   984	        loop {
   985	            let length = buffer.len().min(ceiling - bytes.len() + 1);
   986	            match request.as_reader().read(&mut buffer[..length]) {
   987	                Ok(0) => break,
   988	                Ok(read) if read > ceiling - bytes.len() => return reject(request, 413, too_large()),
   989	                Ok(read) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..read]),
   990	                Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
   991	                Err(error) => return reject(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", format!("cannot read the request body: {error}"))),
   992	            }
   993	        }
   994	        if length.is_some_and(|length| length != bytes.len()) {
   995	            return reject(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", "the request body ended before its declared Content-Length"));
   996	        }
   997	    }
   998	    if method == Method::Post && path == "/assets" {
   999	        return crate::assets::upload(request, bytes, shared);
  1000	    }
  1001	    if method == Method::Post && let Some(id)=path.strip_prefix("/assets/intent/").and_then(|s|s.strip_suffix("/declare")){return crate::assets::declare(request,id,bytes,shared);}
  1002	    if method == Method::Post && let Some(id) = path.strip_prefix("/assets/intent/").and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix("/finish")) {
  1003	        return crate::assets::finish(request, id, bytes, shared);
  1004	    }
  1005	    if method == Method::Post && let Some(id) = path.strip_prefix("/assets/intent/").and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix("/cancel")) {
  1006	        return crate::assets::cancel(request, id, shared);
  1007	    }
  1008	    if method == Method::Get && path == "/assets/intents" { return crate::assets::intents(request, shared); }
  1009	    if method == Method::Get && let Some(id) = path.strip_prefix("/assets/") {
  1010	        return crate::assets::serve(request, id, shared);
  1011	    }
  1012	    let body = match String::from_utf8(bytes) {
  1013	        Ok(body) => body,
  1014	        Err(_) => return reject(request, 400, Refusal::new("E_INPUT", "input", "a JSON request body must be valid UTF-8")),
  1015	    };
  1016	    let request_now = if (method == Method::Get && path == "/changes")
  1017	        || (method == Method::Post && (path == "/sync" || path.starts_with("/q/") || path.starts_with("/m/")))
  1018	    {
  1019	        match shared.advance_time_audiences().map_err(|error| error.refusal()) {
  1020	            Ok(now) => Some(now),
  1021	            Err(refusal) => return reject(request, 503, refusal),
  1022	        }
  1023	    } else { None };
  1024	    if operation && !shared.personas {crate::release_requests::Scope::admit(&shared.release_requests,||*lock(&shared.generation));}
  1025	    match (method, path.as_str()) {
  1026	        (Method::Post, "/dev/clock/advance") => maintenance::advance(request, shared, &body),
  1027	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/jobs/") => maintenance::run_job(request, shared, &path["/jobs/".len()..], &body),
  1028	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/dev/jobs/") => maintenance::run_job(request, shared, &path["/dev/jobs/".len()..], &body),
  1029	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/a/") => actions::call(request, shared, path.trim_start_matches("/a/"), &body),
  1030	        (Method::Post, "/actions/claim") => actions::claim(request, shared, &body),
  1031	        (Method::Post, "/actions/claim-set") => actions::claim_set(request, shared, &body),
  1032	        (Method::Post, "/routes/verify/claim") => routes::claim(request, shared, &body),
  1033	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/routes/verify/") => routes::settle(request, shared, path, &body),
  1034	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/actions/") => actions::settle(request, shared, path, &body),
  1035	        (Method::Post, "/effects/claim") => effects::claim(request, shared, &body),
  1036	        (Method::Post, path) if path.starts_with("/effects/") => effects::post(request, shared, path, &body),
  1037	        (Method::Get, "/effects") => effects::list(request, shared, &url),
  1038	        (Method::Get | Method::Post, "/probe") => match principal_of(&request, shared) {
  1039	            Ok(viewer) => {
  1040	                let identity = shared.read_identity();
  1041	                match identity {
  1042	                    Ok((store_id, seq,generation)) => {
  1043	                        let mut reply = json!({ "ok": true, "store_id": store_id, "seq": seq, "generation":generation,"viewer": viewer.0 });
  1044	                        if query_params(&url).get("scope").is_some_and(|scope| scope == "1") {
  1045	                            reply["kind"] = json!(viewer.1); reply["scope"] = json!(viewer.2);
  1046	                        }
  1047	                        respond_timed(request, shared, 200, reply)
  1048	                    },
  1049	                    Err(error) => respond_timed(request, shared, 500, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&error) })),
  1050	                }
  1051	            },
  1052	            Err(refusal) => respond_timed(request, shared, if refusal.retryable { 503 } else { 401 }, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&refusal) })),
  1053	        },
  1054	        (Method::Get, "/auth/config") => {
  1055	            let (auth, environment) = {
     1	use super::*;
     2	
     3	/// Who is asking: a bearer session, or (in `dev`, from loopback) a persona.
     4	pub(crate) fn principal_of(request: &Request, shared: &Shared) -> Result<snapback4_core::identity::Capability, Refusal> {
     5	    principal_with_owner(request, shared, None)
     6	}
     7	
     8	fn principal_with_owner(request: &Request, shared: &Shared, owner: Option<&Engine>) -> Result<snapback4_core::identity::Capability, Refusal> {
     9	    // Declared public bearer routes keep their existing development admission.
    10	    if !(request.method() == &Method::Post && routes::declared(shared, request.url()).is_some()
    11	        && !request.headers().iter().any(|h| h.field.equiv("x-snapback-persona"))) {
    12	        dev_request(request, shared)?;
    13	    }
    14	    let mut persona = None;
    15	    let mut bearer = None;
    16	    for header in request.headers() {
    17	        let name = header.field.as_str().as_str().to_ascii_lowercase();
    18	        let value = header.value.as_str().trim();
    19	        if name == "x-snapback-persona" {
    20	            if persona.is_some()
    21	                || value.is_empty()
    22	                || !value.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-')
    23	            {
    24	                return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "send exactly one valid x-snapback-persona header").guide("personas"));
    25	            }
    26	            persona = Some(value.to_owned());
    27	        }
    28	        if name == "authorization" {
    29	            let Some(token) = crate::auth::parse_bearer(value) else {
    30	                return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "send Authorization: Bearer <token>").guide("personas"));
    31	            };
    32	            if bearer.replace(token.to_owned()).is_some() {
    33	                return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "send exactly one Authorization header").guide("personas"));
    34	            }
    35	        }
    36	    }
    37	    if persona.is_some() && bearer.is_some() {
    38	        return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "send one credential: a development persona or a bearer token").guide("personas"));
    39	    }
    40	    if let Some(persona) = persona {
    41	        if let Some(engine) = owner { shared.dev_authority(engine)?; }
    42	        if shared.dev_doors() {
    43	            // `use personas` is the cast: a test expecting an outsider to be
    44	            // refused must not see it signed in. No declaration admits none.
    45	            // (Taken briefly; the engine
    46	            // guard, when held, is always acquired before this one.)
    47	            let declared = lock(&shared.bound).personas.clone();
    48	            if !declared.contains(&persona) {
    49	                return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", format!(
    50	                    "persona {persona} is not declared; `use personas {}` is this project's cast. Add {persona} to it (dev re-adopts on save) or send a declared persona", declared.join(", ")))
    51	                    .rewrite(format!("use personas {}{persona}", if declared.is_empty() { String::new() } else { format!("{}, ", declared.join(", ")) })).guide("personas"));
    52	            }
    53	            return Ok((persona_principal(&persona), "persona".into(), snapback4_core::identity::SessionScope::Full));
    54	        }
    55	        return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "personas are a development door; a deployed server takes bearer tokens (snapback4/auth)").guide("personas"));
    56	    }
    57	    if let Some(token) = bearer {
    58	        // Reads may authenticate against the committed generation during adoption.
    59	        // Keep write authentication behind the writer: time queued for adoption
    60	        // must not preserve a session that expired or was revoked in that wait.
    61	        let path = request.url().split('?').next().unwrap_or("");
    62	        let read = detached_request(request.method(), path);
    63	        let resolve = |engine: &Engine, identity: Option<&str>, detached: bool| {
    64	            let now = shared.now();
    65	            let sample = snapback4_core::identity::ServiceSample { now, supervisor_revision: shared.worker_revision.load(Ordering::Acquire) };
    66	            let result = if detached {
    67	                snapback4_core::identity::resolve_read_only_supervised(engine.store(), &token, sample, identity)
    68	            } else {
    69	                snapback4_core::identity::resolve_supervised(engine.store(), &token, sample)
    70	            };
    71	            let result=result.map_err(|error| error.refusal()).and_then(|value|value.ok_or_else(||
    72	                snapback4_core::identity::diagnostics::refused(engine.store(), &token, now, trusted_dev_request(request, shared))));
    73	            if result.is_err() {crate::release_requests::stamp(engine.generation());}
    74	            result
    75	        };
    76	        return if let Some(engine) = owner { resolve(engine, None, false) }
    77	        else if read { match shared.reader() {
    78	            Ok((epoch, reader)) => {
    79	                let identity = lock(&shared.wake).store_id.clone();
    80	                let result = resolve(&reader, identity.as_deref(), true);
    81	                lock(&shared.readers).put(&epoch, reader.into_inner());
    82	                result
    83	            }
    84	            Err(_) if shared.memory_store() => resolve(&lock(&shared.engine), None, false),
    85	            Err(error) => Err(error.refusal()),
    86	        } } else { resolve(&lock(&shared.engine), None, false) };
    87	    }
    88	    Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "sign in: send a bearer token (snapback4/auth), or x-snapback-persona in development").guide("personas"))
    89	}
    90	
    91	// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.001#4-development-doors — a persona cannot cross from authentication into a replacement password-only reader.
    92	pub(crate) fn persona_read_authority(request: &Request, shared: &Shared, engine: &Engine) -> Result<(), Refusal> {
    93	    let Some(persona) = request.headers().iter().find(|header| header.field.equiv("x-snapback-persona")) else { return Ok(()) };
    94	    shared.dev_authority(engine)?;
    95	    let bound = lock(&shared.bound);
    96	    if (!shared.unsafe_dev_doors && bound.schema.auth.password && !bound.schema.auth.guests)
    97	        || !bound.personas.iter().any(|name| name == persona.value.as_str().trim()) {
    98	        return Err(Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "persona authority changed while this read waited; sign in with a password or use the current declared development cast").guide("staging"));
    99	    }
   100	    // The cast is checked at this read's admission. Never hold its publication
   101	    // mutex during I/O: concurrent ordinary writes still need to authenticate.
   102	    // The engine transaction fences a replaced execution schema.
   103	    Ok(())
   104	}

//! Held change polls: JSON whitespace heartbeats, followed by one JSON result.
use super::{
    JsonBuffer, Shared, cors, lock, principal_of, query_params, refusal_json, respond_timed,
    trusted_dev_request,

const HEARTBEAT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

pub(super) fn serve(request: Request, shared: &Shared, url: &str) {
    let params = query_params(url);
    let since: u64 = params.get("since").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    let wait: u64 = super::wait_seconds(url);
    let began = Instant::now();
    let deadline = began + Duration::from_secs(wait);
    let paced = began + Duration::from_millis(100);
    let capability = match principal_of(&request, shared) {
        Ok(principal) => principal,
        Err(refusal) => {
            return respond_timed(request, shared, 401, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&refusal) }));
        }
    };
    if let Err(denied) = crate::device_handshake::check(shared, crate::device_handshake::header(&request), false) {
        return respond_timed(request, shared, 409, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&denied) }));
    }
    let connected = &capability.0;
    // @ref LLP 3000.036#6-idle-live-clients-must-not-cost-a-thread — one principal's tabs cannot take the whole viewer pool; refused at once, never queued.
    let _share = if wait > 0 {
        match shared.long_waits.enter(connected) {
            Ok(share) => Some(share),
            Err(limit) => return super::long_waits::refuse_share(request, shared, limit),
        }
    } else { None };
    let present = capability.2 == snapback4_core::identity::SessionScope::Full;
    let heartbeat = params.get("heartbeat").is_some_and(|s| s == "1") && request.http_version().0 == 1 && request.http_version().1 >= 1;
    let mut response = PollResponse { request: Some(request), started: false, shared };
    let initial = { let wake=lock(&shared.wake); (wake.seq,wake.eph.version.clone(),wake.generation) };
    let epoch = params.get("eph").and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(initial.1.epoch);
    let incarnation = params.get("ephi").cloned().unwrap_or(initial.1.incarnation);
    let interest: Option<std::collections::BTreeSet<String>> = params.get("ephTables").map(|s| {
        s.split(',').filter(|s|!s.is_empty()).map(str::to_owned).collect()
    });
    let wants_ephemeral = ["eph", "ephi", "ephTables"].iter().any(|k|params.contains_key(*k));
    {
        let mut engine = lock(&shared.engine);
        if let Err(why) = super::session_identity::persona_read_authority(response.request.as_ref().unwrap(), shared, &engine) {
            drop(engine); response.finish(401, json!({"denied":refusal_json(&why)})); return;
        }
        if present && let Err(error) = engine.presence_reconnected(&connected, shared.now()) {
            response.finish(500, json!({ "denied": refusal_json(&error.refusal()) })); return;
        }
        if present { shared.presence.enter(&connected); }
    }
    let result = (|| -> Result<_, snapback4_core::RuntimeError> {
        // Entry always reads the store: the client may already know a head
        // committed after the last publication (LLP 3000 finding 5).
        let mut current=read_answer(shared, since)?;
        let mut observed=initial.0;
        let mut sequence_wake=false;
        let mut beat=Instant::now();
        loop {
            // The deadline is private scheduling state. Production polls wake
            // at it even without another application request; development
            // clock jumps run the same advancement through their control
            // request and notify this condition variable.
            let opening = if shared.personas {
                None
            } else {
                shared.next_time_audience()?
            };
            // Snapshot and wait share one mutex. Commit cannot pass between
            // the predicate check and the condvar's atomic unlock-and-wait.
            let wake=lock(&shared.wake);
            if wake.seq != observed {
                observed=wake.seq; sequence_wake=true; drop(wake);
                current=answer(shared, since)?;
                continue;
            }
            let tables=wake.eph.changed(epoch,Some(&incarnation),interest.as_ref());
            let reset=wake.eph.version.incarnation!=incarnation;
            let eph_ready=reset||!tables.is_empty();
            let durable=wake.generation != initial.2 || sequence_wake || current.0!=since || params.get("store_id").is_some_and(|id|Some(id)!=current.1.as_ref());
            let now=Instant::now();
            if durable || now>=deadline || eph_ready && now>=paced {
                let eph=snapback4_core::engine::ephemeral::Change {preserved:wake.eph.preserved_since(epoch,&incarnation),epoch:wake.eph.version.epoch,incarnation:wake.eph.version.incarnation.clone(),tables};
                let generation=wake.generation;
                // Replacement publishes its identity with the incarnation. No
                // engine lock is needed to finish an ephemeral-only wake.
                if reset {current.1=wake.store_id.clone();}
                return Ok((current,generation,eph));
            }
            if heartbeat && now>=beat {
                drop(wake); response.heartbeat().map_err(|e|snapback4_core::RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
                beat=Instant::now()+HEARTBEAT;continue;
            }
            let mut until=if heartbeat {deadline.min(beat)} else {deadline};
            if eph_ready {until=until.min(paced);}
            if let Some(opening) = opening {
                until = until.min(Instant::now() + shared.time_audience_delay(opening));
            }
            #[cfg(test)]
            super::test_work(&shared.poll_wait);
            let (wake, timeout)=shared.polls.wait_timeout(wake,until.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now())).unwrap_or_else(|e|e.into_inner());
            #[cfg(test)]
            super::test_work(&shared.poll_resumed);
            #[cfg(test)]
            if !timeout.timed_out() { super::test_work(&shared.poll_notified); }
            drop(wake);
            if timeout.timed_out()
                && opening.is_some_and(|at| shared.time_audience_delay(at).is_zero())
            {
                shared.advance_time_audiences()?;
                current = answer(shared, since)?;
            }
        }
    })();
    // @ref LLP 3000.033#1.2 — a reader never enters OR leaves presence.
    if present { shared.presence.leave(&connected); }
    // Recheck bearer liveness on a pooled detached reader. Ephemeral-only
    // wakes must not reacquire the serving engine merely to finish a poll.
    let auth_store_id = lock(&shared.wake).store_id.clone();
    let bearer = response.request.as_ref().unwrap().headers().iter().find(|h|h.field.equiv("Authorization")).and_then(|h|crate::auth::parse_bearer(h.value.as_str())).map(|token| token.trim().to_owned());
    let authenticated = match bearer.map(|token| (shared.reader(), token)) {
        None => Ok(()),
        Some((Ok((reader_epoch, reader)), token)) => {
            let resolved = match snapback4_core::identity::resolve_read_only_supervised(reader.store(),&token,snapback4_core::identity::ServiceSample { now: shared.now(), supervisor_revision: shared.worker_revision.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Acquire) },auth_store_id.as_deref()) {
                Ok(Some(current)) if current == capability => Ok(Ok(())),Ok(_)=>Ok(Err(snapback4_core::identity::diagnostics::refused(reader.store(), &token, shared.now(), trusted_dev_request(response.request.as_ref().unwrap(), shared)))),Err(e)=>Err(e),
            };
            match resolved {
                Ok(outcome) => { lock(&shared.readers).put(&reader_epoch, reader.into_inner()); outcome }
                // As for answers: a reader older than a finishing adoption is
                // not a verdict on the session. Ask again behind the engine.
                Err(_) => {
                    principal_of(response.request.as_ref().unwrap(),shared).and_then(|current| {
                        if current == capability { Ok(()) } else { Err(snapback4_core::Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "the poll credential changed")) }
                    })
                }
            }
        }
        Some((Err(_), _)) => {
            principal_of(response.request.as_ref().unwrap(),shared).and_then(|current| {
                if current == capability { Ok(()) } else { Err(snapback4_core::Refusal::new("E_AUTH", "auth", "the poll credential changed")) }
            })
        }
    };
    if let Err(refusal)=authenticated { response.finish(401,json!({"denied":refusal_json(&refusal)}));return; }
    match result {
        Ok(((seq,store_id,tables,preserved,changes),generation,ephemeral))=>{
            let mut reply=json!({"seq":seq,"tables":tables,"preserved":preserved,"changes":changes,"generation":generation,"store_id":store_id});
            if wants_ephemeral {reply["ephemeral"]=json!(ephemeral);}
            response.finish(200,reply);
        }
        Err(error)=>{let why=error.refusal();response.finish(if why.retryable {503}else{500},json!({"denied":refusal_json(&why)}));}
    }
}

type Checked = (u64, Option<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Json);
// @ref LLP 3000.036#6-idle-live-clients-must-not-cost-a-thread — one commit wakes every held poll; they share one answer per cursor.
/// Wake answers by (cursor, published head, generation, store identity). Only
/// a held poll woken by a publication asks here, and an answer is computed
/// after reading that publication, so its snapshot is newer than the poll's
/// entry and than anything its client knew when it asked. The answer names
/// no viewer, so polls from the same cursor share one read: a commit costs one
/// read per distinct cursor, not one per held poll. Entry and unheld polls
/// read the store themselves (the published counter is a wake signal, never
/// the source of truth). A shared answer is at most a second old and never
/// below the cursor; failures are not kept.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(crate) struct Answers { entries: std::collections::VecDeque<((u64, u64, u64, Option<String>), Instant, Checked)> }
const ANSWERS_KEPT: usize = 64;
const ANSWER_AGE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);

fn answer(shared: &Shared, since: u64) -> Result<Checked, snapback4_core::RuntimeError> {
    let key = { let wake = lock(&shared.wake); (since, wake.seq, wake.generation, wake.store_id.clone()) };
    let mut answers = lock(&shared.change_answers);
    if let Some((_, _, hit)) = answers.entries.iter().find(|(k, at, hit)| *k == key && at.elapsed() < ANSWER_AGE && hit.0 >= since) {
        return Ok(hit.clone());
    }
    let checked = read_answer(shared, since)?;
    // Older publications are never asked for again.
    answers.entries.retain(|(k, at, _)| k.1 >= key.1 && *k != key && at.elapsed() < ANSWER_AGE);
    if answers.entries.len() >= ANSWERS_KEPT { answers.entries.pop_front(); }
    answers.entries.push_back((key, Instant::now(), checked.clone()));
    Ok(checked)
}

fn read_answer(shared: &Shared, since: u64) -> Result<Checked, snapback4_core::RuntimeError> {
    let _timing = super::latency::EngineSpan::new();
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::test_work(&shared.changes_refresh);
    if let Ok((epoch, mut reader)) = shared.reader() {
        // A pooled reader can predate an adoption that has committed but not
        // yet replaced the pool. Only a success is kept; anything else is read
        // again behind the engine, which waits for that adoption to finish.
        if let Ok(checked) = check(&mut reader, since) {
            lock(&shared.readers).put(&epoch, reader.into_inner());
            return Ok(checked);
        }
    }
    let mut engine = lock(&shared.engine);
    match shared.open_reader(&engine) {
        Ok(mut reader) => { drop(engine); check(&mut reader, since) }
        // A memory store has no detached reader: read under the engine.
        Err(_) => check(&mut engine, since),
    }
}

/// The notification's head, identity and invalidations share one read snapshot.
fn check(engine: &mut snapback4_core::engine::Engine, since: u64) -> Result<(u64, Option<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Json), snapback4_core::error::RuntimeError,
> {
    use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;
    let all_tables: Vec<_> = engine.schema().visible_tables().map(|(n,_)|n.clone()).collect();
    let schema = engine.schema().clone();
    let tx = engine.store_mut().read_transaction()?;
    let head = tx.next_seq()? - 1;
    let store_id = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'store_id'", [], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?;
    let changes = tx.commits_after(since, 500)?;
    // Advancing to the actual head must not skip invalidation beyond the
    // bounded commit page. Saturation conservatively invalidates every table.
    let mut tables = if changes.last().is_some_and(|(seq, _)| *seq < head) { all_tables }
        else { changes.into_iter().flat_map(|(_, tables)| tables).filter(|name| all_tables.contains(name)).collect() };
    tables.sort();
    tables.dedup();
    let preserved = snapback4_core::revocation::preserved_between(tx.conn(), &schema, since, head);
    let changes = settlement_changes(tx.conn(), &schema, since, head);
    tx.rollback()?;
    Ok((head, store_id, tables, preserved, changes))
}

struct PollResponse<'a> {
    request: Option<Request>,
    started: bool,
    shared: &'a Shared,
}

impl PollResponse<'_> {

// For SVG/foreignObject controls, click the actual rendered box, not a text
// descendant whose DOM geometry Playwright may interpret differently.
async function clickSvg(page, control) {
  await control.waitFor({ state: "visible" });
  const box = await control.boundingBox();
  assert.ok(box && box.width > 0 && box.height > 0, "SVG control has no rendered box");
  await page.mouse.click(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2);
}
